component.name: Turtle64
component.summary: Inspect, convert, hash, and verify N64 ROMs and N64DD disk images

description.p: Turtle64 is a GUI toolkit for Nintendo 64 cartridge ROMs and N64DD disk images. It reads the cartridge header (including the advanced homebrew header) and the 64DD IPL header, detects byte order directly from file contents (never from the file extension), identifies CIC/IPL3 bootcodes (including iQue, Aleck64, and all libdragon open-source IPL3 revisions), and computes CRC1/CRC2 (for legacy emulators and ROM databases) plus CRC32/MD5/SHA-1.

ul.li: Convert between big-endian, little-endian, and byte-swapped ROM formats
Convert between .d64, .ndd, and MAME 64DD disk image formats
Batch process entire folders with a live progress indicator
Verify dumps against No-Intro DAT files (8 N64/64DD/iQue/Aleck64 DAT kinds)
Export single or batch ROM/disk info to text files
Decode Japanese and Chinese header/filename text
Extract files from N64DD MFS disk images

description.p: Turtle64 was inspired by, and celebrates, the classic ROM64 and romjudge utilities.
